title: Gale northwest Mount Sharp complete data kit (terrain + orbital mineralogy)
vertical_units: meters above Mars areoid (source datum); not Earth sea level
grid_order: row-major, rows north to south, columns west to east; binary little-endian float32; cell centers
resolution_note: 20m resampled grid from merged DEM with spatially variable HRSC/CTX/HiRISE/MOLA support, not uniform 1m accuracy
slope_method: atan(hypot(dz/dx,dz/dsouth)), gradient in meters; one-sided at edges; degrees
route: Synthetic example only, not actual rover positions and not safe/optimal route
geology_note: USGS SIM3292 1:20M regional units, clipped to patch; not high-resolution hazards
boxwork_note: This patch has NOT been verified as the boxwork location; chosen to reuse a valid compact DEM subset.

minerals.grid: same 238 x 238 grid, cell size and bounds as the elevation grid; little-endian float32 per band
minerals.source: MRO CRISM MTRDR summary products, observation FRT000058A3 (2007-04-22, Ls 223.9), 18 m/pixel
minerals.registration: co-registered to CTX basemap by albedo matching; label corner offset +38 px east, +6 px south at 18 m; residual < ~40 m
minerals.note: Orbital spectral indices, not mineral abundances; dust suppresses signatures; no rover soil measurements exist inside this patch
minerals.shipped_nodata: none: f32 rasters are fully populated (verified no NaN and no sentinel values); the cells outside the observation strip are gap-filled from nearest measured values
minerals.mask_f32: data/minerals/minerals_mask.f32 (little-endian float32, same grid and cell order; 1.0 = measured, 0.0 = gap-filled)
minerals.coverage_note: coverage_pct is the fraction of patch cells with real measured CRISM values at the documented registration (strip valid-data edge cuts a west/southwest wedge); earlier kit text wrongly said the missing cells were NaN in the f32 files - they are filled, and the mask marks them
